message.avernus.cooldown: The mirror is still recovering (%s s)
realm_aspect.avernus.infernal.desc: Embers drift upward through a sky that burns without fire.
realm_aspect.avernus.silent.desc: Frost and stillness; even the wind forgets how to speak.
realm_aspect.avernus.umbral.desc: Dusk without end; shadows pool where the ground once stood.
realm_trait.avernus.boundless.desc: The surface is sealed whole, without a single hole
realm_trait.avernus.equality.desc: Creatures below the surface are raised onto it
realm_trait.avernus.eternity.desc: The mirror hovers overhead and the realm follows its owner
realm_trait.avernus.freedom.desc: The owner may fly freely inside the realm
realm_trait.avernus.illusion.desc: Hostile creatures ignore players inside until struck
realm_trait.avernus.isolation.desc: The rewritten ground exists for the owner alone
realm_trait.avernus.rebirth.desc: Saves the owner from a fatal blow once, at the cost of the realm
realm_trait.avernus.unreality.desc: The owner is immune to damage with no attacker
realm_trait.avernus.weak_water.desc: The whole surface turns to weak water over a bottomless dark
tooltip.avernus.aspect_hint: Crafting: surround the mirror with eight aspect materials to change its aspect
tooltip.avernus.curio_key: Worn as body charm: press %s to toggle
tooltip.avernus.hint: Hold Shift: aspect · Alt: special effects · Ctrl: usage
tooltip.avernus.invalid_form: Invalid form: unknown or conflicting entries
tooltip.avernus.lore.1: Beyond the glass lies Avernus, the lake no bird may cross;
tooltip.avernus.lore.2: shatter it, and the world beneath your feet is rewritten in its likeness.
tooltip.avernus.sigil_usage: Smithing table: leave the template empty to engrave it into a mirror; a feather removes it
tooltip.avernus.smithing_hint: Smithing: a sigil with an empty template engraves its effect; with a feather it is removed
tooltip.avernus.use: Use to open or close your realm
